claims.assertion: Mari describes the Urmah as large semi-bipedal cats with feline bodies, long spines, short muscular legs, and tails.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu

claims.assertion: She says the Urmah protect smaller feline species represented on their extra-large Federation High Council.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu

claims.assertion: According to Mari, Urmah influence in ancient Egypt predates pharaonic Egypt and included a Federation base beneath Giza.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu

claims.assertion: She speculates classic Egyptian feline deities reflect Urmah heritage, beyond symbolic animal associations.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu

claims.assertion: Mari believes the Cabal downplays the Urmah because they oppose its and the Federation’s agendas for Earth.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
